name: bonumark-stream
tagline: A self-hosted microblog CMS for publishing short-form posts on a site you control.
description: Hardens the public release package by preventing admin ZIP upgrades from duplicating the live media library into each private upgrade backup, completing package-managed cleanup coverage for top-level CHANGELOG.md and analytics.php, aligning installation, upgrade, API, Remote Posting, and OpenAPI documentation with the current release, and adding regression coverage. No database migration is added and existing config, database records, media, uploads, themes, settings, users, content, and runtime data remain preserved.
title: Public Release Hardening Pass
